cultural_categories_verified_en.json.note: 5 cultural categories x 2 clause wordings x 4 topics x 5 status pairs x 3 grammar types = 120 each. original_imperative_declarative_en.json.note: Imperative ('write 5 words') vs declarative ('5 words are written') mood contrast, no status tag -- the axis veerlosar/nuna originally proposed, not covered by the earlier 120-row sets (which varied status-word and register, never mood).
